notes.title: Shadows Of Deceit Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Matteo. Due to recent events, Shadows Of Deceit will have a slight delay, and the game's release is now scheduled for October 2025. I want to sincerely thank everyone who has played the old demo of the game so far and let you know that I’m working hard to make Shadows Of Deceit the best gaming experience possible.

This past year, 2024, has been particularly challenging. I had to deal with the loss of a very important person in my family, which deeply affected all of us. Despite this, I continued working on a coherent storyline, and I’m currently refining and improving some of the game’s mechanics.

Rest assured, Shadows Of Deceit is still in development. I want to keep you all updated on what lies ahead for the game. It will need another year to reach its final form, so I ask for your understanding and patience regarding the release delay.

Thank you all for your support and understanding.
